gridItems.title: Shortcut List Pane
gridItems.desc: The persistent List Pane serves as your central command shortcut bar, aggregating all tasks, calendar events, and active sprints into a unified high-density list. Effortlessly jump between workspace priorities, quick actions, and upcoming milestones without breaking focus or navigating away from your active work.

gridItems.title: Multi-View Engine
gridItems.desc: Switch context-free across four specialized layout perspectives: Calendar View offering Day, Week, and Month schedule grids; List View featuring instant temporal filters to slice tasks across Day, Week, Month, and Year periods; Kanban View for visual drag-and-drop column workflows; and Track View to monitor real-time progress, live execution status, and active change logs.

sections.title: Instant side drawers and quick dialog popups

gridItems.title: Task Details Sidebar

gridItems.title: Task Details Dialog
gridItems.desc: Open lightweight modal dialogs for rapid task editing, tag updates, and blocker checks directly from any list, calendar, or kanban card.

sections.title: Deep task workspaces with AI activity summaries

gridItems.title: Overview Tab
gridItems.desc: Inspect complete task specs, objectives, success criteria, custom parameters, assignees, priority levels, and scheduling metadata.

gridItems.title: Activity Tab & AI Summary
gridItems.desc: Log work updates and collaborate across multi-assignee tasks. Built-in AI agents condense all activity comments and progress notes into instant actionable summaries.

gridItems.title: Dependency Engine

gridItems.title: Immutable History Log
gridItems.desc: Track every change, field edit, assignee update, and status transition across the entire task lifecycle in a complete audit history stream.

sections.title: Move work forward across tools and projects

gridItems.title: Smart Task Filters

gridItems.title: Automated Recurring Tasks

capabilitiesDesc: KeilHQ unifies task tracking, strict dependency logic, native integrations, and granular audit history in one high-performance workspace.
checklistTitle: Built for clarity, collaboration, and total accountability
checklistDesc: Every detail of KeilHQ Task Management is designed to eliminate ambiguity and streamline engineering execution across teams.
checklistItems: Shortcut List Pane: The persistent List Pane acts as a rapid-access shortcut bar, listing all types of tasks, milestones, and upcoming events in one structured view so you can navigate priorities without switching screens.,

Comprehensive Layout Views: View your work through specialized perspectives including Calendar View (Day, Week, Month grids), List View (with instant filters for Day, Week, Month, and Year horizons), visual Kanban Boards, and Track View for real-time progress monitoring and change oversight.,

Fast Overview Sidebar & Dialog: Get a lightweight snapshot of any task using the Task Details Sidebar or quick Dialog popups to quickly review specs, assignees, and blockers without leaving your active workflow.,

4-Tab Task Detail Page: Deep-dive into work items via dedicated tabs: Overview (full parameters & metadata), Activity (collaborative work logs for team members paired with an AI summary engine that condenses updates into key insights), Dependency (enforced blocking logic for tasks, events, and people), and History (an immutable change log of every update).,

Developer Tool Integrations: Bridge project management with developer workflows through native integrations with GitHub (link PRs & issues), Google Meet (generate one-click video meeting links), and Google Calendar (two-way schedule synchronization).,

Multi-Parameter Smart Filters: Surface exact task queues with powerful Smart Filters that instantly query tasks by custom date ranges, urgency levels, assignees, completion statuses, tags, and project boundaries.,

Automated Recurring Tasks: Eliminate manual setup for routine operations by setting up recursive tasks that auto-generate on daily, weekly, monthly, or custom schedules with pre-configured assignees and dependencies.,

Direct Cross-Project Mobility: Seamlessly transfer tasks from one project space to another directly without losing linked dependencies, activity logs, AI summaries, attached files, or historical audit entries.
